title: PortalEnquiryPayload
description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for the Broker CRM Canonical Portal Inbound Webhook Payload (Generic Mock Contract). This schema serves as a proposed common technical standard, NOT an official specification from 99acres, Magicbricks, or NoBroker.

externalEventId.description: Unique external query, enquiry, or event identifier from the portal. Required to enable strong idempotent deduplication.

name.description: Full name of the prospect/buyer submitting the enquiry.

mobile.description: Primary mobile number of the prospect. Must resolve to a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8, or 9. The schema pattern accepts standard unseparated 10 digits ('9810011223'), country prefix ('+91', '91') or trunk prefix ('0'), and optional 5-digit block spacing ('+91 98100 11223', '+91-9810011223'). (Note: At runtime, normalizeIndianMobile() further tolerates parentheses and dots, but callers should format per schema).

email.description: Optional email address of the prospective buyer.

city.description: Target city name where the prospect is searching for property.

locality.description: Preferred locality, sector, or micro-market within the city.

preference.description: Transaction preference. Canonical values are SALE (Buy) and RENT. Synonyms (BUY, PURCHASE, RENTAL) are normalized automatically. Defaults to SALE if omitted in generic ingestion. (Note: In the unverified NoBroker stub adapter, omitted preferences default to RENT).

minBudget.description: Minimum budget in Indian Rupees (INR). Must be a non-negative number.

maxBudget.description: Maximum budget in Indian Rupees (INR). Must be a non-negative number and greater than or equal to minBudget if both are provided. (Note: Validated server-side at the DAL layer; JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 lacks native cross-property arithmetic comparison operators).

propertyType.description: Type of property requested, mapped to internal CRM PropertyType enum.

bedroomConfiguration.description: Preferred bedroom count or BHK configuration string.

advertisedPropertyRef.description: External listing code or property advertisement identifier from the portal. If matched against a brokerage property listing, the enquiry is automatically linked.

enquiryNotes.description: Free-form prospect enquiry text, comments, or portal-generated criteria notes.
examples: Looking for ready-to-move 3 BHK apartment near metro station.
